contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Swipe Navigation Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Swipe navigation settings

actions.description: It will let you choose navigation type

steps: Select your preferred navigation type between Buttons and Swipe gestures.
Optionally toggle on Gesture hint to display guidance lines at the bottom of the screen.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open navigation bar settings under Display

actions.description: It will tune edge swipe distance

steps: Tap More options or Swipe gestures.
Drag sensitivity until back gestures feel natural.

actionableDeeplink.message: Adjust how far from the edge a swipe starts

actions.description: It will find apps covering navigation

steps: Note any app installed just before the issue started.
Disable that app or turn off its display overlay permission.
Test swipe navigation again on the home screen.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open app optimization in device care
actionableDeeplink.message: Close heavy apps that slow the phone

actions.description: It will isolate third party interference

steps: Press and hold the power key.
Touch and hold Power off until Safe mode appears.
Tap Safe mode and test navigation.
Uninstall the conflicting app if swipes work in Safe mode.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open recovery and safe mode guidance
actionableDeeplink.message: Boot with third party apps disabled
